## 📝 Summary
Describe the user-visible or maintainer-facing change.

## 🎯 Motivation
What problem does this solve?

## 🔧 Change details
- [ ] Application code
- [ ] Templates/UI
- [ ] Dataset/model artifacts
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] CI/configuration
- [ ] Security/privacy/accessibility

## 🧪 Verification
List commands and checks actually run, with outcomes.

## 🗺️ Model and data impact
If artifacts or training inputs changed, include dataset provenance, build identifier, filtering settings, artifact checksums, and alignment validation. Never include private user records.

## 🔐 Security and privacy
Describe input validation, secret handling, logging, and data exposure implications.

## ♿ Accessibility
Describe keyboard, focus, labels, alt text, contrast, and responsive checks for UI changes.

## 📷 Screenshots or diagrams
Attach genuine before/after screenshots where relevant. Do not fabricate UI evidence.

## 📚 Documentation
- [ ] README updated if user-facing behavior changed
- [ ] Relevant docs and diagrams updated
- [ ] Changelog updated where appropriate

## ✅ Checklist
- [ ] Existing files and behavior preserved unless change is intentional
- [ ] No secrets or unnecessary personal data added
- [ ] No unverified claims or fake metrics
- [ ] Known limitations and failed checks disclosed
